subject: English Language & Literature
basis: BCS_English_Final: Lecture 05 (Verbs — Finite, Non-finite, Causative & Linking)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'Would you mind ___ the window?'
questions.e: mind (আপত্তি করা)-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'She enjoys ___ detective novels.'
questions.e: enjoy-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'He has just finished ___ the report.'
questions.e: finish-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'I could not help ___ at his joke.'
questions.e: can't help (না করে পারা যায় না)-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'The committee postponed ___ the meeting.'
questions.e: postpone-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'The accused denied ___ the money.'
questions.e: deny-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'She is busy ___ her assignment.'
questions.e: busy-এর পরে V-ing।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'This museum is worth ___.'
questions.e: worth-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'He is averse ___ hard.'
questions.e: averse to-এর to preposition, তাই gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'She refused ___ the bribe.'
questions.e: refuse-এর পরে to-infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'We decided ___ early in the morning.'
questions.e: decide-এর পরে to-infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'The boy pretended ___ asleep.'
questions.e: pretend-এর পরে to-infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'The climbers managed ___ the summit before dark.'
questions.e: manage-এর পরে to-infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'We cannot afford ___ a new car this year.'
questions.e: afford-এর পরে to-infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'The students stopped ___ when the teacher entered.'
questions.e: stop + V-ing = কাজটি থামানো; stop + to V = অন্য কাজের জন্য থামা।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'On his way home he stopped ___ some bread.'
questions.e: stop + to V = কোনো উদ্দেশ্যে থামা (রুটি কেনার জন্য)।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'I remember ___ him at the book fair last year.'
questions.e: remember + V-ing = অতীতের ঘটনা মনে পড়া।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'Remember ___ the door before you leave.'
questions.e: remember + to V = ভবিষ্যতে করণীয় মনে রাখা।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'I will never forget ___ the sea for the first time.'
questions.e: forget + V-ing = অতীতের অভিজ্ঞতা ভোলা।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'We regret ___ you that your application has been rejected.'
questions.e: regret + to V = (দুঃখের সঙ্গে) জানাচ্ছি; regret + V-ing = অতীত কাজের জন্য অনুশোচনা।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'I heard her ___ a beautiful song.'
questions.e: hear/see/feel (perception verb) + object + bare infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'You had better ___ a doctor at once.'
questions.e: had better-এর পরে bare infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'I cannot but ___ his courage.'
questions.e: cannot but (না করে পারি না)-এর পরে bare infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'You need not ___ there now.'
questions.e: need যখন modal (need not), তখন bare infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'He bade me ___ at once.'
questions.e: bid + object + bare infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'The water is clean enough ___.'
questions.e: adjective + enough + to-infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'He has a habit of ___ late at night.'
questions.e: preposition (of)-এর পরে gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'Smoking is injurious to health.' — Here 'Smoking' is a/an—
questions.e: subject হিসেবে noun-এর কাজ করছে — gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: In which phrase is the '-ing' word a gerund?
questions.e: swimming pool = সাঁতারের জন্য পুল (উদ্দেশ্য বোঝায়) — gerund; swimming boy = যে সাঁতার কাটছে — participle।
questions.t: উদ্দেশ্য = gerund, কর্তা নিজে করছে = participle।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: In which phrase is the '-ing' word a participle?
questions.e: sleeping child = যে শিশু ঘুমাচ্ছে — participle; sleeping bag = ঘুমানোর ব্যাগ — gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'Having completed the survey, the team returned.' — Here 'Having completed' is a/an—
questions.e: Having + pp = perfect participle; একটি কাজ শেষ করে আরেকটি।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'Do not sit on the broken chair.' — Here 'broken' is a/an—
questions.e: broken = past participle, chair-কে বিশেষিত করছে।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'To err is human.' — Here 'To err' is a/an—
questions.e: to + V1, subject হিসেবে noun-এর কাজ।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'I saw him crossing the road.' — Here 'crossing' is a/an—
questions.e: object (him)-এর অবস্থা বোঝাচ্ছে — participle।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'He has no house to live in.' — Here 'to live in' is a/an—
questions.e: house-কে বিশেষিত করছে — adjectival (qualifying) infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'Weather permitting, we shall go out.' — 'Weather permitting' is a/an—
questions.e: নিজস্ব subject (Weather) ও participle (permitting) নিয়ে মূল বাক্য থেকে স্বতন্ত্র — nominative absolute।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: 'Seeing is believing.' — Both 'seeing' and 'believing' are—
questions.e: উভয়ই noun-এর কাজ করছে (subject ও complement) — gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
o: Walking along the road, a snake was bitten by him.
While he was walking along the road, a snake bit him.
Walking along the road, a snake bit him.
While walking along the road, a snake bit him.
questions.e: Dangling participle: participle-এর কর্তা ও মূল clause-এর subject এক হতে হবে; নইলে মনে হয় সাপ হাঁটছিল।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
o: Having eat our lunch, we resumed the work.
Having eaten our lunch, the work was resumed.
Having eaten our lunch, we resumed the work.
Having eaten our lunch, the work resumed.
questions.e: perfect participle-এর কর্তা (we) মূল clause-এর subject হতে হবে; Having + pp।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: The infinitive form of a verb is generally—
questions.e: infinitive = to + V1 (to go, to read); কখনো to ছাড়া (bare infinitive)।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: A verb ending in '-ing' that works as a noun is called a—
questions.e: V-ing noun-এর কাজ করলে gerund (verbal noun)।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: A verbal adjective is called a—
questions.e: participle verb ও adjective উভয়ের কাজ করে।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Which of the following is a bare infinitive?
questions.e: to ছাড়া infinitive = bare infinitive; let/make/see/hear-এর পরে।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
questions.dup: পাস — ৪১-১৮৪-এ ‘I will not let you go’-এ go কী তা জিজ্ঞাসিত; এখানে bare infinitive-এর ধারণা (নিকট-সম্পর্কিত, পর্যালোচিত)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'It was difficult for us ___ the river in the storm.'
questions.e: It + adjective + for + object + to-infinitive।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'He came here ___ a job.'
questions.e: উদ্দেশ্য বোঝাতে to-infinitive (infinitive of purpose)।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'I object ___ in this manner.'
questions.e: object to + gerund; passive gerund = being + pp।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
questions.dup: পাস — ৪৬-১৪, ৪৬-১৫-এ avoid/in fear of-এর পরে passive gerund জিজ্ঞাসিত; এখানে object to-এর পরে (নিকট-সম্পর্কিত, পর্যালোচিত)

questions.q: Choose the correct form: 'There is no point in ___ about it now.'
questions.e: There is no point in + gerund।
questions.src: Lecture 05 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Swan — Practical English Usage; Wren & Martin)
